profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · AWS Cloud · React/Angular
profile.jobTitle: Senior Java Software Engineer (Services Engineering Group)
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with over 9 years of experience building and modernizing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and AWS. I specialize in designing cloud-native microservices, migrating legacy systems, and developing full-stack solutions with React and Angular.

My work focuses on delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance software through clean design, automation, and collaboration in Agile teams. I take pride in writing maintainable code, optimizing performance, and using tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate development and improve quality.

💻 Technical Skills & Expertise

🧠 Programming Languages:
Java · C · C# · NodeJS 

🌐 Web & Cloud Technologies:
Java · Spring Boot · J2EE · RESTful & SOAP Web Services (JAX-RS, JAX-WS) · React · Angular 7–8 · HTML5 · CSS3 · XML · JSON

🗄️ Databases:
Oracle · MySQL · SQLite · AWS DynamoDB

⚙️ Frameworks & Tools:
Spring · Spring Boot · JMS · Maven · Gradle · Git · SVN · Docker · AWS ECS Fargate · CloudFormation · SAM · CloudFront · API Gateway · Lambda · SQS · SNS · SES · S3 · EC2 · CodePipeline

☁️ Cloud & DevOps:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microservices Architecture · Cloud-Native Application Development · CI/CD Pipelines · Containerization · Cloud Automation

🤖 AI & Productivity Tools:
GitHub Copilot

💡 Specialties & Interests:
Enterprise Application Development · Full Stack Development · Cloud-Native Microservices · Legacy System Modernization · REST API Design · Event-Driven Architecture · Agile/Scrum Collaboration

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer (Services Engineering Group)
Java Software Developer
positions.insights: Core Java, Spring Boot and +7 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built microservices and cloud‑native applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, NodeJS, and AWS services.
• Developed advanced REST APIs and integrated distributed systems using messaging (SQS, SNS, JMS) and structured data formats (JSON, XML, CSV).
• Implemented system‑to‑system integrations including IBM ACE pipelines supporting large‑scale modernization efforts.
• Migrated enterprise legacy applications to AWS using ECS Fargate, CloudFormation, ECR, RDS, EC2, ALB, VPC, and Docker.
• Built AWS serverless microservices using API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, SES, S3, WebSocket, and Step Functions.
• Created replication pipelines to migrate customers from legacy Java platforms to cloud‑native AWS architectures.
• Translated large portions of legacy Java code into NodeJS Lambda microservices for modernization.
• Developed UI‑integrated features using React, J2EE, Spring Data Repository, and QueryDSL.
• Prepared applications for secure production deployment, converting on‑prem services to Windows‑service–compatible applications.
• Leveraged AI‑assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to accelerate development and improve code quality.

positions.title: Service Developer
positions.description:
• Developed J2EE and Spring‑based REST/SOAP services supporting MVNO systems provisioning over 26 million customers.
• Built Angular 7 and J2EE full‑stack applications using JWT/LDAP authentication.
• Enhanced and troubleshot large‑scale SOAP/REST services integrating with major wireless carriers.
• Developed enterprise applications using Spring, Spring Boot, Jersey, JAX‑RS, and JAX‑WS.
• Implemented JDBC/JPA data layers for Oracle within WebLogic environments.
• Created asynchronous messaging workflows using JMS and callback servlets.
• Supported enterprise Java deployments and managed JMS configurations in WebLogic.
